articles.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
articles.snippet: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

articles.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
articles.snippet: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

articles.title: The crypto wallet that grew up inside Telegram is striking out on its own
articles.snippet: The app will offer crypto trading, tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs, and perpetual futures, all already available through Telegram.

articles.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
articles.snippet: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.snippet: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.
